turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_supercon_train.csv: 300 real materials, columns `composition`
    (element fractions as a compact formula string) and `target` (the
    measured critical temperature Tc (K)).
  - b3_supercon_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE materials whose critical temperature
    Tc (K) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and `composition`.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST critical
temperature Tc (K), then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training data show that the highest measured \(T_c\) values (110–137 K) belong exclusively to a small number of closely related cuprate families: Hg/Tl-1223, Tl-2223/2212 and Bi-2223/2234 (all containing Cu–O planes, alkaline-earth cations and Hg, Tl or Bi). Rare-earth 123 cuprates top out near 94 K and all other families (borocarbides, pnictides, A15, etc.) lie far lower.

Direct composition analogues in the candidate pool are therefore:

- c029 \((\mathrm{Cu,Ag})\mathrm{Ba}_2\mathrm{Ca}_3\mathrm{Cu}_4\mathrm{O}_{11}\) matches the 115 K Cu/Tl-1223 example,
- c034 \(\mathrm{Tl}_2\mathrm{Ba}_2\mathrm{Ca}_5\mathrm{Cu}_6\mathrm{O}_{16}\) belongs to the same Tl-22\((n-1)n\) series whose \(n=2,3\) members reach 108–110 K,
- c046 \(\mathrm{Bi}_{1.7}\mathrm{Pb}_{0.2}\mathrm{Mo}_{0.1}\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{Ca}_2\mathrm{Cu}_3\mathrm{O}\) is essentially identical to the 106–111 K Bi-2223 examples,
- c081 \(\mathrm{Bi}_{3.2}\mathrm{Pb}_{0.2}\mathrm{V}_{0.6}\mathrm{Sr}_4\mathrm{Ca}_5\mathrm{Cu}_7\mathrm{O}\) scales onto the 105 K Bi-2223/2234 solid-solution example,
- c097 \(\mathrm{Bi}_{1.6}\mathrm{Pb}_{0.4}\mathrm{Sr}_2\mathrm{Ca}_3\mathrm{Cu}_4\mathrm{O}\) matches the 103 K Bi-2234 example.

All remaining candidates map onto families whose training \(T_c\) values are \(\le 95\) K. Ranking the five analogues by the \(T_c\) of their nearest training neighbours yields the order below.

Final: c029, c034, c046, c081, c097
